## NWI - BC Sales Orders -> HubSpot Deals (daily): set up before publishing
1. Connect credentials: **HubSpot Service Key account** (deals read/write) and **Business Central – NWI Group (client credentials)**. Confirm no "not connected" warning remains on any node.
2. Settings -> Error Workflow: set the shared error handler (not set in this file).
3. Settings -> Timezone is Australia/Sydney, so *Every Day At Midnight* means midnight Sydney. Check it.
4. BC web service **SalesOrder** (page 42) must stay published. Standard API `salesOrders` is used to find changed orders.
5. HubSpot dropdowns `print_option`, `fob_option`, `product_category` must hold the same text as BC. A BC value HubSpot does not accept fails that batch (the error handler alerts; the run is safe to repeat).
6. **Workflow Config** holds: lookback window (25h, one hour of overlap), batch size, and the BC-field -> HubSpot-property map.

**What it does:** finds BC sales orders created or changed in the last 25 hours, reads them in batches, finds the matching deals by `bc_order_id`, and updates only the properties whose value differs. BC wins. A blank in BC never clears HubSpot. Deals are never created.
**Safe to re-run:** it only writes values that differ.
**API calls for N changed orders:** 1 BC list + N/50 BC reads + N/50 HubSpot searches + changed deals/100 HubSpot updates.

## 1. Find changed BC orders
One call lists every order created or modified in the lookback window.

## 2. Read details + find deals
Batches of orders: BC details in one call, matching deals in one HubSpot search.

## 3. Write only what changed
Compares BC to HubSpot and updates up to 100 deals per call.

nodes.name: Every Day At Midnight
nodes.notes: Runs once a day at midnight (workflow timezone: Australia/Sydney). Production runs only - publish the workflow.

nodes.name: Workflow Config
nodes.notes: lookbackHours: how far back to look for changed orders (25 = daily run + 1h overlap). batchSize: orders per BC read / HubSpot search. fieldMap: BC sales order page field -> HubSpot deal property.

nodes.name: List Changed BC Orders
nodes.notes: One call: every sales order created or modified in the window (created in n8n or directly in BC).

nodes.name: Build BC Read Batches
nodes.notes: Splits the order numbers into batches (batchSize each). One item per batch.

nodes.name: Read BC Order Details
nodes.notes: One call per batch: all the fields we sync, for up to batchSize orders.

nodes.name: Find Matching Deals
nodes.notes: Read-only search (POST is only the HubSpot search convention): one call finds the deals for a whole batch of orders.

nodes.name: Compare And Build Updates
nodes.notes: Keeps only properties that differ. Blank BC values are ignored. No changes = no output, so the next node does not run.

nodes.name: Update HubSpot Deals
nodes.notes: Batch update, up to 100 deals per call. Updates only: deals are never created. Setting the same value twice is harmless, so retry is safe.
